title: Linear recurrence from a rational power series
statement:
Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], $C(T)=\sum_{n\geq0}c_nT^n\in K[[T]]$ a formal power series [def-weil-formal-power-series], and $P,Q\in K[T]$ polynomials [def-weil-polynomial-ring] with $Q(0)=1$ and $QC=P$ in $K[[T]]$ [def-weil-polynomial-as-power-series]. Write $Q=\sum_{j\geq0}b_jT^j$ with $b_j=[T^j]Q$ [def-weil-polynomial-coefficient], so $b_0=1$; let $d=\max(\deg Q,1)$, and let $m\geq0$ be an integer with $[T^N]P=0$ for every $N\geq m+d$ (for instance $m=\deg P+1$, or $m=0$ when $P=0$). Put $a_i=b_{d-i}$ for $0\leq i\leq d-1$. Then $(c_n)$ satisfies the linear recurrence of order $d$ with coefficients $a_0,\ldots,a_{d-1}$ from the index $m$ on [def-weil-eventual-linear-recurrence]:
$$
c_{n+d}+a_{d-1}c_{n+d-1}+\cdots+a_0c_n=0\qquad(n\geq m).
$$
(If $Q=1$, then $d=1$, $a_0=0$, and the conclusion says $c_{n+1}=0$ for $n\geq m$.)
